name: Artículos · Generador Diario (9 AM PT)
description: Generates one draft article every day at 9 AM Pacific Time (17:00 UTC, PST-anchored — drifts to 10 AM during PDT, same convention as the weekly digest). Rotates through a curated topic list, calls /api/articles/generate on centavos.mx with the x-cron-article header, then inserts the returned article into the `articles` collection as `status=draft` for the editor to review before publishing.
